engineering_model.input_mapping: ProLN root L receives min(1,left+0.5*front), root R min(1,right+0.5*front), unknown side receives 0. Equal per-cell input; no bilateral population-size balancing. Pulse applies on transitions 0->1 through pulse_steps-1->pulse_steps.
engineering_model.weight_rule: ENGINEERING: log1p(Cpre,post), normalized by max(1,incoming column log sum) or the largest such column sum; multiplied by presynaptic assumed sign. Structural contacts unchanged.
engineering_model.sign_rule: Unsigned: all +1. Predicted: only agreeing body/consensus acetylcholine (+1) or gaba (-1) with finite body confidence >= threshold; all other cells use explicit zero/positive fallback. Glutamate and modulators are ambiguous; no receptor-specific effect is known.
engineering_model.time_unit: abstract simulation step, not biological seconds
engineering_model.cumulative_unit: sum of activation samples including resting step 0; arbitrary activity-step units
